description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kurinjampittiya, Kalpitiya D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 410079 (23/0390)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title for specific land parcels (Plot Nos. 1:6, 1:8, and 1:11) in Kalpitiya, including detailed particulars about land ownership, extent, classification, and encumbrances. This falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registration, title determination, and property ownership matters.
